positions.thesis: Long GLD because gold offers diversification against equity concentration, fiscal uncertainty, and potential real-yield compression. Thesis is wrong if GLD breaks below $364 by December 9, 2026; reassess after 30 days if momentum fails.

Long SPY because broad US corporate earnings resilience and continued institutional equity demand can sustain the uptrend despite elevated valuations. Thesis is wrong if SPY falls below $730 by December 9, 2026, signaling deteriorating market breadth and trend support.

Long XLE because energy equities offer a differentiated source of returns if commodity supply constraints and shareholder distributions remain supportive. Thesis is wrong if XLE falls below $59 by December 9, 2026; exit if relative strength against SPY fails to improve within 30 days.
